en: A colorized historic view of a fortified medieval town with stone towers, church spires, and red‑roofed houses. In the foreground is a sloping path with small buildings and trees; in the middle stands a large church and several round and square towers connected by old city walls. Printed text at the top identifies the place as Bautzen in Saxony and highlights the Michaelis Church and the old waterworks tower.
